installer.description: Configure this Oracle Linux host as a KVM virtualisation environment

preChecks.errorMessage: CPU does not support hardware virtualisation (vmx/svm)

preChecks.errorMessage: KVM kernel module is not loaded

preChecks.name: Libvirt Service
preChecks.command: systemctl is-active libvirtd.socket || systemctl is-active libvirtd

configFields.description: Libvirt NAT network for the Splunk VM (192.168.110.0/24)

commands.cmd: sudo virsh pool-define-as wizard-pool dir --target {{storagePoolPath}} 2>/dev/null || echo 'Pool may already exist'
sudo virsh pool-start wizard-pool 2>/dev/null || echo 'Pool already started or is default'

installSteps.name: Base Image Setup
installSteps.description: Copying base VM image to storage pool

commands.cmd: test -f {{baseImagePath}} && echo 'Base image found' || (echo 'ERROR: Base image not found at {{baseImagePath}}' && exit 1)
test -f {{storagePoolPath}}/oracle-desktop-9.qcow2 && echo 'Base image already in storage pool' || sudo cp {{baseImagePath}} {{storagePoolPath}}/oracle-desktop-9.qcow2
commands.description: Copying base image to storage pool (skip if exists)
Verifying base image in storage pool

installSteps.name: Splunk Network Configuration
installSteps.description: Setting up NAT network for Splunk VM (192.168.110.0/24)

commands.cmd: echo '<network><name>{{splunkNetworkName}}</name><forward mode="nat"/><bridge name="{{splunkNetworkName}}" stp="on" delay="0"/><ip address="192.168.110.1" netmask="255.255.255.0"><dhcp><range start="192.168.110.100" end="192.168.110.254"/></dhcp></ip></network>' | sudo tee /tmp/wizard-net-splunk.xml > /dev/null
sudo virsh net-define /tmp/wizard-net-splunk.xml 2>/dev/null || echo 'Network may already exist'
sudo virsh net-start {{splunkNetworkName}} 2>/dev/null || echo 'Network already active'

installSteps.name: FreeIPA Network Configuration
installSteps.description: Setting up NAT network for FreeIPA VM (192.168.120.0/24)

commands.cmd: echo '<network><name>{{ipaNetworkName}}</name><forward mode="nat"/><bridge name="{{ipaNetworkName}}" stp="on" delay="0"/><ip address="192.168.120.1" netmask="255.255.255.0"><dhcp><range start="192.168.120.100" end="192.168.120.254"/></dhcp></ip></network>' | sudo tee /tmp/wizard-net-ipa.xml > /dev/null
sudo virsh net-define /tmp/wizard-net-ipa.xml 2>/dev/null || echo 'Network may already exist'
sudo virsh net-start {{ipaNetworkName}} 2>/dev/null || echo 'Network already active'

commands.description: Installing Cockpit and VM management plugin

commands.cmd: sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 && echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward=1' | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.d/99-kvm.conf > /dev/null
commands.description: Enabling IP forwarding for VM networking

commands.cmd: sudo sysctl -w net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=0 2>/dev/null && echo 'net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=0' | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.d/99-kvm.conf > /dev/null || echo 'bridge-nf module not loaded (OK)'

echo '=== KVM Host Summary ===' && echo 'Hostname: '$(hostname) && echo 'Timezone: '$(timedatectl show -p Timezone --value) && echo '' && echo '=== Virtualisation ===' && sudo virsh version 2>&1 && echo '' && echo '=== Networks ===' && sudo virsh net-list --all 2>&1 && echo '' && echo '=== Storage Pools ===' && sudo virsh pool-list --all 2>&1 && echo '' && echo '=== Base Image ===' && ls -lh {{storagePoolPath}}/oracle-desktop-9.qcow2 2>/dev/null || echo 'No base image found'
